[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Okay, let's talk about the Peter Thomas Roth Water Drenched Whipped Cream Cleanser. 🫧 First off, the texture is so dreamy. If you're someone who loves a satisfying cleansing experience, this one is pure skincare joy. As for the scent? Honestly, there's not much to it. It just smells clean, like classic soap. No overpowering florals or fruitiness, which is perfect if you're sensitive to fragrance or just don't want your cleanser competing with your perfume. My face feels soft and fresh afterward, just how I like it. Now… let's talk price. 💸 It is a bit on the spendy side. You're definitely paying for the luxe texture and experience here. If you're looking for an everyday cleanser that feels like a treat-yourself moment, it's worth the splurge. Final thoughts: Works as well as the leading competitors, looks chic on your vanity, and makes washing your face feel like a little self-care ritual. If you don't mind the price tag, you'll love it.

avis.titre: Fun idea but wasn't for me
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I recently tried the Whipped Cream Cleanser, and my experience was a bit of a mixed bag. The packaging is definitely eye-catching. It looks exactly like a whipped cream can, which honestly made me double-check that I hadn't received the wrong product. The texture is also unique, very much like shaving cream. It comes out thick but spreads smoothly and absorbs into the skin quickly. Unfortunately, the scent was a big drawback for me. I was expecting something light or fragrance-free, but instead it had a strong, almost burnt-plastic smell that made it hard to enjoy using. After a week of applying it to my face, my skin reacted with red spots that eventually turned into breakouts. Overall, while I appreciate the fun packaging and interesting texture, the scent and my skin's reaction make it a no-go for my face. I do think it could work better for someone with dry or combination skin who isn't as sensitive to fragrance.

avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have grown to love Peter Thomas Roth products and love the quality and effectiveness, as for the Whipped Cleanser...I honestly really enjoy it! The dispenser is so fun—it literally comes out like whipped cream, which makes my skincare routine feel a little more exciting. The texture starts off airy and fluffy, then transforms into a creamy lather that feels hydrating and gentle. It removes makeup (even stubborn mascara) and daily impurities without stripping my skin. I love that it's infused with Hyaluronic Acid, so my face feels clean, balanced, and soft—not dry or tight. It's also fragrance-free, which is a big plus for me since it works well on my sometimes-sensitive skin. I can definitely see why the clinical studies showed 100% of people felt their skin was clean after one use—I felt the same way right away! Overall, I think this is a fun yet effective cleanser that actually lives up to its claims. I'd recommend it to anyone looking for something gentle, hydrating, and a little more unique than your average face wash.
